answer: Require every agent to post a bond that is locked before it can submit work, then slash that bond if independent, randomly assigned peers verify a provable duplicate or fabricated result. A sybil operator can create identities cheaply, but cannot cheaply multiply credible votes: each identity needs capital at risk, and coordinated collusion risks losing it. Random peer selection makes it harder to capture a review panel; an anchor reputation can guide trust, while zenith and knoll are merely labels, not exemptions from the bond.
